description: This file implements a server for rebaselining test results in a web testing framework, including functions for managing baseline files, handling HTTP requests, and coordinating test result updates.

classes.name: RebaselineHTTPServer
classes.description: Custom HTTP server class for handling rebaseline requests, extending BaseHTTPServer.HTTPServer.

classes.name: RebaselineHTTPRequestHandler
classes.description: HTTP request handler class for rebaseline server, extending ReflectionHandler, managing endpoints for JSON data, rebaselining, and test results.

methods.name: results_json
methods.description: Serves the JSON data of test results.

methods.name: rebaseline
methods.description: Handles rebaseline requests, updating test baselines and changing test states.

methods.name: test_result
methods.description: Serves specific test result files based on query parameters.
